content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary objective lacks estimand specification",
      "quote": "To determine confirmed objective response with CMP-001 in combination with nivolumab in subjects with refractory unresectable or metastatic melanoma",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Synopsis Objectives",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is stated without a corresponding estimand, which is required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025 to define the treatment effect precisely (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure).",
      "fix": "Add an estimand section specifying the population, endpoint definition, handling of intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death), and population-level summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent primary endpoint definition between synopsis and body",
      "quote": "Objective response rate (ORR), defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1) as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Synopsis Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis defines ORR by BICR, but the body (Section 10.4, if present) may use investigator assessment; this discrepancy must be resolved to avoid ambiguity in the primary analysis.",
      "fix": "Ensure the primary endpoint and analysis in the body match the synopsis (BICR) or explicitly state the primary analysis uses BICR with investigator as sensitivity."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements referenced but not detailed",
      "quote": "Women of childbearing potential must have negative serum pregnancy test before dosing at W1D1 and be willing to use an adequate method of contraception (Section 4.3.2.)",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria 11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol references Section 4.3.2 for contraception details, but that section is missing from the provided text, leaving requirements undefined (e.g., acceptable methods, duration for males).",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception requirements section specifying acceptable methods, duration, and male contraception if applicable."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial stopping rules not described",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Methodology",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions 'a reason for treatment discontinuation' but does not specify trial stopping rules (e.g., futility, safety, or efficacy thresholds) as required by ICH M11 Section 4.3.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination due to safety, futility, or overwhelming efficacy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Access to trial intervention after end of trial not addressed",
      "quote": "Amendment 2 (Version 3.0) 26 August 2021 1 Confidential",
      "page": 1,
      "section": "Title Page",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe post-trial access to CMP-001 or nivolumab for participants who may benefit, which is required by ICH M11 Section 4.5 and SPIRIT 34.",
      "fix": "Add a section on post-trial access, including whether continued treatment will be provided and under what conditions."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screen failure and rescreening criteria missing",
      "quote": "Subjects enrolled in the study must meet all of the following inclusion criteria to be eligible.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define screen failure or rescreening procedures, which is necessary for operational clarity and to avoid unnecessary repeat screening.",
      "fix": "Add a section on screen failure and rescreening, including conditions under which a subject may be rescreened."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lifestyle restrictions not specified",
      "quote": "Treatment with complementary medications (eg, herbal supplements or traditional Chinese medicines) to treat the disease under study within 2 weeks before start of study treatment.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Exclusion Criteria 3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions prohibited medications but does not address lifestyle restrictions (e.g., alcohol, smoking, diet) that may affect trial conduct or safety.",
      "fix": "Add a lifestyle restrictions section detailing any prohibitions or recommendations during the trial."
    },
    {
      "title": "Data sharing and patient involvement not described",
      "quote": "CONFIDENTIALITY STATEMENT The information in this document contains trade secrets and commercial information that is privileged or confidential",
      "page": 1,
      "section": "Confidentiality Statement",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks sections on data sharing (SPIRIT 6) and patient and public involvement (SPIRIT 11), which are required for transparency and compliance with modern trial standards.",
      "fix": "Add sections on data sharing plans and patient/public involvement in trial design and conduct."
    }
  ]
}
